copy.en:
Foldable Phone Holder On Handle
The foldable holder keeps your phone visible while the two-zone interior separates travel essentials.
TSA combination lock supports faster customs inspection
Wet-dry pocket, zippered mesh pocket, and X-shaped straps

copy.it:

copy.es:
Soporte plegable para teléfono en el mango
El soporte plegable mantiene visible el teléfono; el interior de dos zonas separa los artículos.
Cerradura de combinación TSA para una revisión más rápida
Bolsillo seco-húmedo, bolsillo de malla con cremallera y correas en X

design_brief_zh: 主卖点为“拉杆上的可折叠手机支架”，以功能与实际使用收益为核心，不重复八轮或铝合金拉杆卖点。PC画布2000×2000：左侧文案区[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.10,0.38,0.80]，右侧产品区[x,y,w,h]=[0.49,0.08,0.46,0.84]；阅读顺序为标题、支持说明、TSA锁细节、内部收纳细节。右侧展示与实物一致的旅行箱，以约45度角打开箱体，拉杆伸出并清晰展示支架处于展开状态；同时完整呈现双区内衬，一侧为干湿分离袋和网格拉链袋，另一侧为X型固定带固定衣物，箱体边缘可自然带出TSA密码锁。移动端1200×1200：产品区[x,y,w,h]=[0.08,0.05,0.84,0.53]置于上方，文案区[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.64,0.90,0.31]置于底部，按相同四行顺序重新排版；德语文案预留约20%横向扩展空间。画面采用欧洲现代旅行摄影、低饱和中性色与自然光，柔和侧上方光线突出箱体纹理、内衬分区、手机支架和锁具细节，避免强反光遮挡结构。字体使用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线字体，标题最大，支持说明次之，两个细节作为短标签；数字、TSA和结构名称保持清晰。第一行对应支架特写与主视觉焦点，第二行对应手机可见性及双区内衬，第三行对应锁具局部，第四行对应内部三项收纳结构。所有视觉仅呈现已提供的功能，不添加认证、耐用性测试或其他未证实规格。
compliance_note_zh: 仅展示已提供的可折叠手机支架、双区内衬、干湿分离袋、网格拉链袋、X型固定带和TSA密码锁；不得暗示官方背书、绝对安全或保证更快通关，不添加未提供的认证、测试、静音或防水等表述。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium European modern travel photograph of the supplied YWJ model 13A suitcase, matching the actual product shape, colors, materials, vertical shell texture, aluminum frame, and hardware. PC composition: leave the left 38% as a clean, softly contrasting copy area and place the open suitcase on the right 46%, angled approximately 45 degrees. Show the telescopic handle raised with its foldable phone holder clearly visible and opened, with a phone positioned naturally for viewing; do not exaggerate the holder size. Open the suitcase wide enough to clearly show the two-zone polyester interior: one side with a wet-dry separation pocket and a zippered mesh pocket, the other side with X-shaped garment straps securing clothing. Include a visible TSA combination lock near the frame as a secondary detail. Use low-saturation neutral tones, natural soft side-top lighting, realistic textile and shell textures, and subtle travel context without distracting props. Mobile composition: place the product in the upper 53% and reserve the lower 31% for copy, maintaining clear separation and generous margins. Use product-focused depth of field, accurate proportions, and no competitor branding. Do not render any text, letters, logos, labels, badges, icons, measurements, or graphic typography in the image.
